name.text: Evaluating limits of functions (a and b)

questiontext.text:
Evaluate the value of the following limit:

Note: Give your answer in fraction form or correct to \(2\) decimal places

\(\displaystyle \lim_{{@var_letter@}\rightarrow {@val_limit@}}{@eqn@} =\)[[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]][[feedback:prt1]]

generalfeedback.text:
Worked solution

[[ if test='eqn = eqn_1' ]] \(\begin{align*} \lim_{{@var_letter@}\rightarrow {@val_limit@}}{@eqn@} &= \lim_{{@var_letter@}\rightarrow {@val_limit@}}{@eqn@} \cdot \frac{{@sqrt(var_letter^2+var_2)+var_1@}}{{@sqrt(var_letter^2+var_2)+var_1@}} \\ & = \lim_{{@var_letter@}\rightarrow {@val_limit@}} \frac{\left ({@sqrt(var_letter^2+var_2)-var_1@}\right ) \left ( {@sqrt(var_letter^2+var_2)+var_1@}\right )}{{@den_eqn@} \left ({@sqrt(var_letter^2+var_2)+var_1@}\right )}\\ & = \lim_{{@var_letter@}\rightarrow {@val_limit@}} \frac{\left ( {@sqrt(var_letter^2+var_2)@}\right )^{2}-{@var_1@}^2}{{@den_eqn@} \left ({@sqrt(var_letter^2+var_2)+var_1@}\right )}\\ & = \lim_{{@var_letter@}\rightarrow {@val_limit@}} \frac{{@var_letter@}^{2}}{{@den_eqn@} \left ({@sqrt(var_letter^2+var_2)+var_1@}\right )}\\ & = \frac{1}{ \left ({@sqrt(var_letter^2+var_2)+var_1@}\right )}\\ & = \frac{1}{ {@sqrt(val_limit^2+var_2)+var_1@}}\\ &= {@ta_1@}\\ \end{align*} \) [[ else ]] \(\begin{align*} \lim_{{@var_letter@} \to {@val_limit@}} {@eqn@} &= \frac{{@num_eqn@}}{{@den_eqn_1@}} \\ &= {@sol_1@} \\ &= {@sol_2@} \\ &= {@ta_2@}\\ \end{align*} \) [[/ if]]
